description_en: Enables a physical connection in the Confirmed state. After the operation is complete, the connection enters the Enabled state
description_zh: 开通处于Confirmed状态的物理专线，开通完成后物理专线进入Enabled状态
kebab_example: aliyun vpc enable-physical-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-2zeoaxkq3x0000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --by-pass-sp false --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnablePhysicalConnection

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to bypass the service provider (SP) subscription lifecycle. Valid values:

- **true**: Bypasses the SP subscription lifecycle. This means the instance is no longer managed by the Alibaba Cloud subscription system.

- **false** (default): Does not bypass the SP subscription lifecycle.

> To use this feature, contact your account manager.

- **false**（默认值）：不跳过SP。
